title: Local browser bridge and MCP command routing

checkpoint.summary: Generic Jarvis Edge/Chromium browser bridge with manually registered tabs plus opt-in agent-created tabs. New BrowserOpenTab command opens a background tab on a manually approved origin, automatically registers it, preserves same-origin SPA navigation, and respects revocation. Latest commit 308a651 (protocol 3.20), superseding the earlier implementation checkpoint.
checkpoint.nextAction: Independent security review and real Edge integration testing of popup opt-in, host permissions, BrowserOpenTab, automatic registration, same-origin navigation, JavaScript execution, reconnect and failure outcomes. Then coordinate client/server/extension release. Do not merge/deploy before acceptance.
verified: dotnet test Jarvis.slnx --no-restore: 60 server tests and 275 client tests passed
